caption: Allen & Ginter, Beaver, from the Quadrupeds series (N41), a cigarette card (1890)
alt: A colour-printed card headed “Allen & Ginter, Richmond Straight Cut No 1 Cigarettes”: a tawny beaver with a dark, scaly tail drags a branch in its teeth across a heap of sticks by a pond, framed by pines and a waterfall; in a small roundel below, a beaver sits on its lodge at dusk; lettered “Beaver.”
bibliography: Allen & Ginter. Beaver, from the Quadrupeds series (N41) for Allen & Ginter Cigarettes. 1890, commercial colour lithograph by Lindner, Eddy & Claus, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, The Jefferson R. Burdick Collection, 63.350.202.41.4.
title: Beaver, from Quadrupeds series (N41) for Allen & Ginter Cigarettes
